name: product-recap
description: Turn one or more repos' git history into a product-evolution story and a single-file HTML slide deck. Run from any directory: inside a git repo it mines local clones on the canonical branch (origin/default); outside a repo it resolves the repo from natural language against the Mercaso org and mines master. Merge sibling repos into one deck, scope to a sub-path, pick a time window (open-ended or a closed range); verify flows in code, narrate for non-engineers, build and visually verify the deck.

interface.shortDescription: Git history → product story → HTML slide deck (any repo).
interface.longDescription: Summarize a window of git commits from one or more local repos into a non-engineer-friendly product-evolution story, with code-verified flow descriptions, then render it as a single-file HTML slide deck with built-in macOS rendering verification. Runs from any directory, mines the canonical branch (origin/default) so the checkout branch doesn't matter, merges sibling repos into one deck, and can scope to a sub-path.
defaultPrompt: Use $product-recap to turn last month's commits into a shareable deck.
